mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_refund_channel_query_rate_bucket ( channel_code, window_started_at, used_count, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{channelCode}, NOW(), 0, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refund_channel_query_rate_bucket SET used_count = CASE WHEN window_started_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{windowSeconds}, NOW()) THEN 1 ELSE used_count + 1 END, window_started_at = CASE WHEN window_started_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{windowSeconds}, NOW()) THEN NOW() ELSE window_started_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE channel_code = #{channelCode} AND ( window_started_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{windowSeconds}, NOW()) OR used_count < #{maxQueries} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_refund_channel_query_rate_limit_log ( rejection_no, channel_code, refund_order_id, window_seconds, max_queries, rejected_at ) VALUES ( #{rejectionNo}, #{channelCode}, #{refundOrderId}, #{windowSeconds}, #{maxQueries}, NOW() )
